gate.title: Play
gate.sub: Dash shows you around · about 45 s · sound on

slides.say: Hi, I'm Dash. savethis works with your favorite AI assistants to keep everything you love in one place. Let me show you.
Save anything you love, here or through your AI assistant. A title, a link, a TikTok.

wait.prompt: What should I show you next?
wait.nudge: Pick one of the two, and I'll show you that.

slides.say: I file it in the right pile and look it up: the score, the trailer, where to watch, and why you'll like it.
All of it is open to your favorite AI assistants. The more you save, the more useful they get.
They can even deal you decks of recommendations based on what you already like. Swipe through them in the savethis app to react.

wait.prompt: Want a nudge when a new deck is dealt?

slides.say: The more you save, the more useful your AI assistants get. savethis: a passport for your taste.
